sentences.text: The documents do not state a maximum interest rate for UCB on MSE loans.

The bank policy says rates of interest on retail loans shall be determined in accordance with the Interest Rate Policy approved by the Board of Directors, and the cited RBI UCB directions here address pre-payment charges and disclosure, not a maximum interest rate for MSE loans.
